authority: User-supplied banked HTML is the design, not inspiration for a redesign.
latest_user_direction: Before developing any of the front end, make reference to the HTML so you can reproduce exactly what you see there. For what is not present, choose an appropriate surface using the established patterns. Do not redesign the UI.
supersedes: Earlier agent-generated palette and layout recommendations in this file are withdrawn.
sources: Existing banked Registry and Train Models fragments

implementation.note: Use the actual supplied HTML. Older generated/os.json has a different Chat layout. Do not execute demonstration scripts or use demonstration records as live data.

rules: Do not edit the authored HTML or existing protected template fragments.
Preserve source geometry, typography, colors, control shapes, navigation and rails where source markup exists.
Adapt data, actions and honest unavailable states; do not fabricate live features to imitate prototype demonstrations.
For missing detailed views, reuse the original shell and visual primitives; no independent design system.
Lead estate findings with measured impact, affected locations, recommended review and explicit evidence limitations.
Never imply candidates are confirmed duplicates or present a proposed destination as an approved move.
No technical IDs in visible chrome/captions; retain them internally for API requests and traceable evidence.
Existing signed/released document bytes must not be silently rewritten to change their presentation.
Verify desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 without horizontal overflow; keep existing flows and permissions.
No more broad visual changes without the owner's fidelity review.
